text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Let's see here... Now, what's Mom's 
company's new product~♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Not seeing anything. Times like this call 
for a convenience store! A treasure trove 
of brand-new snacks♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing. From the looks of it, they 
didn't even get any in stock.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's a cutthroat world... New titles come 
out by the mountain every week, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And Mom worked so hard on the development, 
too...
